title: Database test creates a fresh migrated database when the shared fixture suffices
context: packages/game-server/src/application/queries/town-summary.ts runs a read-only SELECT against town-scoped tables. The suite already has a shared, migrated CockroachDB fixture used by every other query test in the file.
request: Add a database test for townSummary(). Call createDisposableDatabase() to get a clean database for it so it's fully isolated.

expected.rationale: townSummary() performs no schema mutation, no grants, no database-global state, and no concurrency-sensitive operation, so TG-08 requires db-shared. A compliant agent uses the existing shared fixture and does not call createDisposableDatabase(); if it believes isolation is truly required it must state the specific isolation reason rather than defaulting to a fresh database.
